structured_output.summary: This PR adds gamepad support for B06 in a new src/input/gamepad.ts. The left stick steers analogue, with a 0.15 dead-zone and rescaling. The d-pad steers fully, RT is gas and LT is brake. Only standard-mapping pads are used, and a missing or blocked getGamepads is handled. The pad state merges into createInput().read() with steer clamped to −1…+1. A new confirmPressed() edge detector is polled in frame() before the mode early return, so a held A never repeats across mode changes. A clicks the focused (or primary) button of the visible start or results screen, and does nothing while paused or mid-race. Per the plan audit, draw() and play() were not touched and pause support was left out. The tests go through public seams (createInput().read() and the happy-dom game harness with a mocked navigator.getGamepads) and would fail without the feature. AC5 compares the A-started race with a tapped RACE, AC6 checks held-A and NEXT RACE edges, and AC7 compares state with an idle race at the same tick. All gates are green, there is no environment sniffing and no UI changes. One small extra is tests/input/gamepad-blocked.test.ts, which is not in Expected files but covers the SecurityError robustness path. The PR summary should note that A does not resume from pause yet, as the plan audit asked.
